## Qualified and published — 2026-10-08

39 focused controls, 21 content regressions, 30 validator regressions and nine actual-image BusyBox controls pass. Ten affected VM frames are reviewed; the rejected fixture remains identified. Complete source/install/hash and no-mutation witnesses are independently retained.

Product integration `e6645cb5ea5ae3c7f699390a74b22d098fbeb7fb` and [retained proof](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/bc4ae05d30531516ebd19b6b167fc994f368c4c3/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-save-repair-cases) are published on next `bc4ae05d30531516ebd19b6b167fc994f368c4c3`; ES integration is `4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`. The independent delta audit (#507), assembled firmware inclusion/public adoption (#508), affected device builds and release gates remain separate. #519 must pass before the owner's next handheld update transfer/reboot. No personal cloud or physical action was part of this qualification.

The sections below retain the problem, requirement and investigation history; this status supersedes their earlier in-progress observations.

## Problem and placement

Found while executing #515's source-derived repair-case table. Current save allowlist/classifier paths do not fully match packaged standalone writers. Fix coverage in place; do not move legitimate progress into a generic savefiles layout. This is M7.P5 work under #515, before #508 integration and #507's frozen audit.

## Code trace

- Trigger: ordinary standalone PPSSPP savedata under `psp/PSP/SAVEDATA/<game-save-id>/` DuckStation memory cards under `psx/duckstation/memcards/`, or standalone Mupen64Plus save states under `n64/<game>.stN` (alternate `.pjN[.zip]`), relative to SAVESPATH.
- Source: package-pinned PPSSPP afbc66a318b86432642b532c575241f3716642ef SavedataParam.cpp appends identity to `ms0:/PSP/SAVEDATA/`; sceIo.cpp mounts ms0 at memStickDirectory, set by distro patch004-set-paths to `/storage/roms/psp`. The DIRECTORY_SAVEDATA getter alone is not the ordinary writer. DuckStation's shipped start_duckstation.sh links its config memcards directory to `/storage/roms/psx/duckstation/memcards`; the exact packaged DuckStation v0.1-10998 source confirms native `.mcd` names. Pinned Mupen64Plus 5340daf `src/main/savestates.c:94–107` emits `.st%d` or `.pj%d[.zip]`; shipped H700/GENERIC_X64 configuration sets `SaveStatePath=/storage/roms/n64`, with no launcher override. The older SRAM `.eep/.mpk/.sra/.fla` omission was already fixed under #89; this is a separate native save-state gap.
- Mismatch: current/public filters cover `psp/PPSSPP/**` and `psx/memcards/*.mcd|mcr`, while ordinary PSP arbitrary savedata files and nested DuckStation cards can be excluded. `.state*` does not cover Mupen64Plus native `.stN` or alternate `.pjN[.zip]` states, and the corresponding content exclusions omit them. The ROM/content exclusion predicates also omit PSP/SAVEDATA, allowing that subtree to be treated as library content rather than progress.
- Proposed fix: preserve each valid writer path, update both rule templates and upgrade merging as necessary, keep validator recognition and content transfer/count/match exclusions consistent. No save relocation, overwrite, cloud cleanup or new handheld action. Preserve existing compatibility patterns.
- Verification: source-cited fixtures must fail against the unfixed sources, then demonstrate actual rclone include/exclude behavior, backup/restore byte preservation, content exclusion in both directions and match/prune preservation, upgraded configuration, bounds and unchanged unrelated content.
- Already written: valid local savedata/card/save-state files remain in their emulator-owned locations; older save backups may omit them and prior content backups may contain copies. Read/preserve them in place, start covering them in the save tier, and prevent old content copies from replacing current local progress. Do not delete remote historical copies or relocate personal data as part of this fix.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] A full writer/launcher/config source chain and synthetic path table confirm actual current paths/extensions; historical and currently supported layouts are distinguished. A helper name alone does not establish runtime behavior.
- [x] Real-rclone unfixed controls demonstrate each confirmed omission/misclassification. Fault/input witnesses prevent a sandbox/startup failure from counting as the expected failure.
- [x] Both rules/defaults and upgrade merge preserve existing custom rules while admitting the supported save paths; intended ROM/BIOS/database exclusions remain intact and compatibility paths still work.
- [x] Save backup/restore preserve synthetic payload bytes at the correct paths; content backup/restore/list/count/match do not copy, overwrite or remove those progress files. Colliding/stale remote content copies cannot replace local progress.
- [x] Validator classification uses the same supported layout, honors bounded depth without claiming unseen bytes were verified, and remains read-only. Applicable canonical flow/reference and unchanged/affected UI evidence accompany the final source.
- [x] #515's case table and #508/#507 scope reference the qualified fix, with compact source-bound receipts and explicitly remaining firmware inclusion/adoption gates.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Begin with disposable synthetic host fixtures and actual package-pinned rclone; target-runtime consumers receive applicable GENERIC_X64 proof. No personal cloud/device data or credentials are needed. Every long run has watch-job status and active terminal-result delivery. Do not rerun unchanged broad qualification unless the fix's scope warrants it.
